revisions.title: Candidate — public Git with a local private evidence lane
revisions.summary: ## Candidate — public Git with a local private evidence lane The personal default aims to commit nearly all durable definitions, code, decisions, and public-safe evidence to GitHub. Data that the operator wants processed, logged, or audited but not published takes an intake-shaped local lane: an operator-configured ignored store holds the governed source, pure functions derive bounded views, and a Clean Room promotion step decides whether any sanitized projection, fixture, or conclusion may enter Git. The comparison should state the common purpose, why the alternative was forced, and the outcomes and guarantees that differ.

revisions.summary: 9. **A support ablation trial.** The outside write-up contrasts a run without guidance and a run with guidance, but it changed three things at once, so it gives the shape of an ablation, not a result. revisions.title: Structural performance guards in place of timers.
revisions.summary: 4. **Structural performance guards in place of timers.** The outside repository guards import cost by asserting, in a fresh interpreter, which modules are absent and which top-level packages loaded, so a regression fails under any host load. DotLn bounds performance only by durations (WO-197's two-times bounds, gate deadlines, hook timings), and product 07 says such comparisons do not establish reliability under all host loads; `--import` instrumentation already has precedent in DotLn tests.
